name: Niko
blurb: ugly, smelly & convinced you are the coolest one here. you live off cement & spite, and you are wanted for tax evasion in 3 states. somehow everyone still knows your name

name: Ponsuke
blurb: the one everybody loves. you smile with your tongue out, you love watermelon unprompted & you make strangers cry in a good way. the cleric of the friend group

name: Agu
blurb: you are the party. always holding a drink, always the last to leave & nobody can confirm which photos of you are actually you. king behavior

name: Hiyori
blurb: the accomplice. you have broken out of everywhere anyone ever put you & you drank their drink on the way out. sneaky, wicked & weirdly jolly about it

name: Yo-chan
blurb: grumpy, round & an excellent jumper. you squint at anyone who talks to you before you have eaten, you are in bed by 9 & you would die for your family. gyu

name: Damn seal
blurb: a visual-technological nightmare. you flash, you shake & you crash the web. you have broken at least one computer & you would do it again

name: Bobo the Clown
blurb: the clown. you cannot tie a balloon, everything goes wrong & everybody is laughing. but you get back up every single time, and honestly that is the strongest thing here

name: Snacksuke
blurb: born in 1859 & doing great. rich, busy & always pitching a new snack. you have a 5 year plan & a business card for every occasion. not to be confused with ponsuke
